title: The Default tag sits after COD's icons and on one row only
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has every standard term switched on and still uses COD as the default for new customers.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the COD row reads "COD", then the info icon, then the lock icon, then a "Default" tag. No other row carries a "Default" tag.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R11: “The shop's default term shows a "Default" tag after its name (after the info and lock icons for COD and Due on Receipt). Exactly one row carries the tag.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Active tab: one table", "Row menu: COD, the default"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.
